TEACHER EDUCATION PATHWAYS COURSE SYLLABUS
Education for personal renewal and social transformation.
A leading future-ready education university responsive to national and global development goals and directions
Philippine Normal University is committed to lead innovative, responsive and sustainable teacher education programs that set the standards of future-ready teachers and education leaders. As the National Center for Teacher Education, the Philippine Normal University commits to provide inclusive, innovative, impactful, and sustainable teacher education programs that produce future-ready teachers and education leaders imbued with the values of truth, excellence, and service. Furthermore, PNU shall ensure the continual improvement of its Quality Management System through compliance with International Quality Standards and statutory and regulatory requirements. PNU shall achieve these commitments through its core functions of instruction, research, extension, and production. Digitally Literate and Data-Driven Decision Maker Design Thinker and Innovator Discerning and Compassionate Person Dynamic Lifelong Learner and Leader Deeply Rooted Global Citizen The College of Teacher Development (CTD) is committed to champion quality teacher education in the country. It is dedicated to:
1.​ Provide future-ready teacher development through innovative, inclusive and quality-assured academic programs. 2.​ Lead in advancing teacher education research and translating scholarly work into relevant policies and practices that benefit
education and communities. 3.​ Establish CTD as leader in producing impactful educational resources, and programs. 4.​ Establish a robust international presence through strategic collaborations, advancing the College’s leadership in teacher
education. 5.​ Maintain a pool of faculty experts who lead as influential public intellectuals in education and related disciplines. 6.​ Established well-defined systems-based solutions and sustainability practices to ensure efficiency and effectiveness of
implementation of CTD Programs and procedures.

Course Intended Learning Outcomes

PPST Strand 1.1 Content knowledge and its application within and across curriculum areas PPST Strand 1.5 Strategies for developing critical and creative thinking, as well as other higher-order thinking skills PPST Strand 4.1 Planning and management of teaching and learning process PPST Strand 4.3 Relevance and responsiveness of learning programs PPST Strand 4.5 Teaching and learning resources including ICT PPSH 2.6 Emerging Opportunities and Challenges

TP-S-ICT03
Troubleshooting Techniques
None
This practice-oriented course explores the purposes, principles, and foundations of troubleshooting. It includes normal system operations and operating parameters, which help students to apply troubleshooting processes. It also enhances students' skills in assembling and disassembling the system unit. Students are expected to solve process-based troubleshooting situations and provide/produce a troubleshooting flowchart.
●​ Gender Literacy – this theme supports the learning of the practical layer of the academic concepts of gender. It looks into creating gender awareness and sensitivity through understanding how different signs, gestures, words, behavior and everyday activities affect the marginalized.
●​ Local, National, Global Systems, Structures, and Processes ●​ Culture and Intercultural Relations SDG 4 – Quality Education 4.4: Technical and vocational skills for employment. SDG 12: Responsible Consumption and Production 12.5: Waste reduction through reuse and repair.

Course Intended Learning Outcomes (CILOs)

Evidence of Performance

Performance Standard

Apply occupational health and safety procedures, industry standards, and professional ethics in ICT servicing environments while demonstrating awareness of sustainable practices and gender-inclusive workplace
culture.

• Safety checklist completion• Laboratory observation records• Safety poster/infographic project• Written safety assessment• Gender sensitivity reflection

• 100% compliance with ESD and electrical safety protocols• Zero safety violations during labs• Correct use of PPE in all hardware handling• 85% or higher on safety knowledge assessment• Demonstrates inclusive language and practices

Diagnose and resolve computer hardware and software issues using systematic troubleshooting methodologies (CompTIA/Cisco 7-step method) while maintaining accurate technical documentation.

• Troubleshooting simulation results• Technical documentation portfolio• Case study analysis reports• Diagnostic accuracy logs• Root cause analysis papers

• 90% successful diagnosis rate on simulated faults• Complete documentation for all repair cases• Follows 7-step methodology systematically• 85% accuracy in hardware vs. software differentiation• Proper use of diagnostic tools and validation procedures

Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware components and peripheral devices according to manufacturer specifications and industry best practices to optimize system performance and extend equipment lifecycle.

• PC disassembly/assembly practical exam• Component identification test• BIOS configuration tasks• Thermal paste application demonstration• Preventive maintenance checklist

• 95% accuracy on component identification• Zero component damage during assembly/disassembly• Completion within industry-standard timeframes• Proper thermal management techniques applied• Correct BIOS/UEFI configuration settings• Demonstrates lifecycle extension practices (SDG 9.4, 12.5)

Install, configure, update, and troubleshoot operating systems and device drivers to ensure system stability, security, and optimal hardware-software integration.

• OS installation project• Driver management scenarios• System utility usage demonstrations• Backup and restore procedures• Event log interpretation tasks

• 85% or higher on OS installation and configuration tasks• Successful resolution of driver conflicts• Proper use of Device Manager and system utilities• Accurate interpretation of system logs and errors• Successful backup/restore implementation

Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot various printer types and peripheral devices while applying sustainable practices to reduce waste and resource consumption.

• Printer troubleshooting practical exam• Maintenance procedure demonstrations• Sustainability analysis report• Peripheral device diagnostics• EPSON facility tour reflection

Troubleshoot network connectivity issues, perform advanced system diagnostics, and implement comprehensive technical solutions

• Network diagnostic practical exam• Command-line tool usage assessment• Advanced troubleshooting scenarios• Final technical case presentation• Reflective

• 80% or higher on printer troubleshooting exam• Correct identification of printer types and issues• Proper cleaning and maintenance without damage• Integration of sustainable practices (SDG 12)• Successful peripheral device configuration and repair
• 85% or higher on network connectivity diagnostics• Correct use of ipconfig, ping, tracert commands• Resolution of complex system issues using advanced tools•

PNU is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive academic environment for students from various backgrounds, including those with disabilities, exceptionalities, ethnic and linguistic differences, religious affiliations, gender identities, and other individual differences. The University ensures its commitment to equal access, participation, and engagement with educational opportunities that supports our academic culture and values as well as celebrate diversity and inclusivity.
If you have any physical or psychological/ mental health conditions or challenges which can affect your performance in class, you are encouraged to inform me. This is to ensure that we are creating and fostering a responsive classroom environment. You are also encouraged to avail of the services of the following offices regarding your challenge/ condition: - Student Affairs and Services Office: counselingservices@pnu.edu.ph - University Health Services Unit: uhsu@pnu.edu.ph - Gender, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusivity Office: gedio@pnu.edu.ph
